# @three-ws/witness

> Turn a real user session into a runnable failing test. A tiny, privacy-first session recorder that captures intent (not pixels, not DOM mutations) and compiles it into a Playwright spec that stays red until the reported bug is fixed.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/witness
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/witness/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/witness
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/witness/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and full API reference
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/witness/llms-full.txt): the entire README as plain text
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/witness/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for coding agents

- [Contributing](https://github.com/nirholas/witness/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
